items.title: openjk: fix build with cmake 4

items.content_html:
Summary

  • Fixes taskwarrior2 build failure with CMake 4
  • CMake 4 removed compatibility with versions < 3.5, causing build to fail
  • Sets CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM to 3.5 to restore compatibility

Test plan

  • Built taskwarrior2 successfully with nix-build -A taskwarrior2
  • All tests passed during build

Fixes #449826
